title: Kingston Sweet Candy Floss 120ml Shortfill 0mg (70VG/30PG)
description:
Made in the UK
– 0mg Nicotine Strength
-100ml E-Liquid Content in a 120ml Shortfill Bottle
– Space for 2 x 10ml (18mg) Nicotine shots
– 70VG/30PG
– Childproof Cap and Tamper Evident Seal
– Recyclable Bottle
– TPD Complaint
Flavours:
Strawberry Candy Floss
Blending the sweet distinctive fruity taste of strawberries with mouth watering cotton candy for a sweet and delightful flavoured blend.
Blue Raspberry Candy Floss
Brings the ripe, fruity taste of blue raspberries with that of tantalising cotton candy for a sweet filled delight that recalls memories at a carnival.
Toffee Candy Floss
The succulent blending of lip smacking toffee with that of sweet cotton candy for a delightful flavour that will leave on taste buds sizzling.
